messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  (All dates are in 2023.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend span (including the holiday) |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** (observed) | Jan 2 (Mon) – Jan 1 was a Sunday holiday | Jan 1–2 |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, BC, AB, SK, MB, NB, PE) | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18–20 |
| **Good Friday** (most provinces) | Mar 31 (Fri) | Mar 31–Apr 3 (includes Easter Monday) |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Mon) | May 20–22 |
| **Canada Day** (observed) | Jul 3 (Mon) – Jul 1 was a Saturday holiday | Jul 1–3 |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Mon) | Sep 2–4 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Mon) | Oct 7–9 |
| **Remembrance Day** (observed) | Nov 13 (Mon) – Nov 11 was a Saturday holiday | Nov 11–13 |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Mon) | Dec 23–25 |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces have additional holidays that don’t create long weekends (e.g., Quebec’s Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day on Jun 24).  
> • The “observed” dates are the days when the holiday is officially taken off work if the actual holiday falls on a weekend.

Feel free to plug this list into your holiday‑planning app!
